**Our Purpose

**Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

**Experience & Skills

**

• 4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

Department: **Indirect Tax Team

****Location: Bagsvaerd, Denmark

****Your impact begins here

**As VAT Manager, you will help shape how we manage indirect tax in a complex global business. You will combine strong VAT expertise with digital innovation, making our VAT reporting and advisory more transparent, efficient and data-driven.

You will contribute to our digital transformation — from SAP S/4HANA to AI-powered solutions — connecting your VAT expertise with smart solutions that improve how we work. This is an opportunity to take ownership, deliver quality at pace and make an immediate difference in a global business.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A Master’s degree in auditing, law or similar field

• 3-5 years of experience in indirect tax, preferably with a focus on EU VAT legislation.

• The ability to assess indirect tax implications of complex business activities while making your guidance clear and actionable for people at different levels of the organisation.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex VAT legislation, work with data and turn your findings into practical, well-founded recommendations.

• Experience with SAP is considered an advantage, and familiarity with AI or AI-enabled solutions would be beneficial.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English.

• A collaborative mindset and the confidence to challenge existing ways of working constructively.

You are proactive and structured, with a strong sense of responsibility.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Act as a trusted internal VAT advisor across multiple tax jurisdictions, translating complex requirements into practical business guidance.

• Contribute to our indirect tax technology strategy and support the transition towards increasingly digital and AI-enabled tax solutions.

• Help strengthen VAT-related master data and establish clear, well-documented processes for its ownership, quality and maintenance.

• Improve indirect tax reporting and advisory processes to strengthen compliance, transparency and operational efficiency.

• Manage VAT compliance activities, including VAT returns, EC Sales Lists, Intrastat and related filings, helping ensure accurate and timely submissions.

• Partner with stakeholders on business projects and decisions where VAT expertise can make an immediate difference.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Corporate Tax department at Novo Nordisk and work as part of our global tax organisation.

Your role will bring you into close collaboration with colleagues and business stakeholders across Denmark and internationally. You will connect specialist VAT knowledge with business needs, data, technology and processes, giving you broad exposure to both operational topics and larger transformation initiatives.

The environment calls for collaboration at speed and practical expertise, with opportunities to influence how indirect tax is managed as the organisation continues to grow and evolve.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will grow by deepening your expertise within a global tax organisation, contribute to significant business projects and help transform complex indirect tax requirements into solutions that work in practice.

You will work on questions that matter today while also helping develop processes, master data and digital solutions that will support the organisation tomorrow.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to use your VAT expertise to influence important business decisions and help shape more digital, efficient indirect tax processes, apply for the VAT Manager role by November 24th, 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions, please reach out to Mette Just Danielsen, Indirect Tax Director at +45 34 44 27 81.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we are committed to advancing sustainable and energy-efficient solutions that help our customers and communities thrive. As a Global Demand Planner (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring our business has a reliable, data-driven view of future customer demand, enabling informed decisions across the value chain.

You will serve as a critical link between our commercial organization and supply chain teams, transforming data, market insights, and stakeholder input into robust demand forecasts. Your work will directly influence inventory levels, production planning, capacity utilization, and customer satisfaction.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking with business understanding. As part of our continued global growth, you will help shape best practices, drive continuous improvement, and create alignment across functions, while leveraging data and technology to make a measurable impact on our customers and business performance.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and continuously improve demand forecasts for assigned products, markets, or business areas by combining data analysis with commercial and market insights.

• Lead the monthly demand planning process and drive alignment with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Supply Planning, and other key stakeholders.

• Analyze demand trends, forecast performance, and market developments to identify risks, opportunities, and actions that support better business decisions.

• Translate customer developments, product launches, phase-outs, and other business changes into accurate and actionable demand plans.

• Collaborate closely with Supply Planning to align demand and supply while supporting inventory, service, and operational targets.

• Contribute to the enhancement of demand planning processes, tools, automation, and digital capabilities to strengthen forecasting effectiveness.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Educational background in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• Experience in demand planning, forecasting, S&OP, or a related supply chain discipline.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to transform data into meaningful business insights and recommendations.

• Experience working with Excel, ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, or related technologies; knowledge of IBP is an advantage.

• Good understanding of forecasting principles and demand drivers, combined with the ability to communicate insights, challenge assumptions, and influence stakeholders across functions.

• A structured, proactive, and self-driven approach, combined with strong collaboration skills and professional English communication abilities.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Strategic Procurement Specialist – Indirect Goods & Services

**Do you find motivation in building value through teamwork, strategic sourcing, and productive supplier partnerships? Would you like to help shape procurement decisions across Nordic retail organizations and contribute to a more efficient and sustainable business? Then keep reading.

As our new Procurement Specialist, Indirect Goods & Services (IGS), you will play an important role in developing category plans, managing sourcing projects, and partnering with colleagues across the Nordic markets to identify opportunities and deliver value.

As a member of our Indirect Goods & Services (IGS) team, you will report to the Head of Procurement, Nonfood and contribute to advancing the IGS agenda throughout the Nordics.

**What You'll Be Doing

**In this role, you will:

• Develop and execute category plans and sourcing strategies across assigned indirect goods and services categories

• Deliver cost savings, working capital improvements, and other value-creation initiatives

• Manage end-to-end sourcing projects, including analysis, tender management, supplier selection, negotiation, and implementation

• Negotiate and manage commercial agreements while ensuring compliance with procurement governance and policies

• Build and maintain positive supplier relationships, promoting performance, innovation, and continuous improvement

• Provide strategic procurement support and advisory to internal stakeholders across the Nordic organizations

• Utilize market insights, benchmarking, and data analysis to support decision-making and identify new opportunities

• Support process enhancements and contribute to the continued evolution of procurement tools and best practices

**What We're Looking For

**We know that great candidates do not always meet every requirement, but we imagine that you bring:

• 1-5 years of experience within procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, or a related commercial discipline

• Experience managing supplier relationships and commercial negotiations

• Solid analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into practical recommendations

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a changing business environment

• Knowledge of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies, and contract management

• Experience working with data, Excel, and procurement-related systems

• Interest in IT/AI is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Professional proficiency in English and at least one Nordic language

**Who You Are

**You enjoy working with people and building relationships across different functions and cultures. You combine strategic thinking with a practical approach and are at ease working through both complexity and change.

**You Are Likely Someone Who

**

• Communicates clearly and builds trust with colleagues and partners

• Takes initiative and follows through on commitments

• Collaborates effectively across teams and markets

• Is curious, methodical, and open to new perspectives

• Stays organized while managing multiple priorities

• Approaches challenges with a positive and solution-oriented mindset

• Works well both on your own and as part of a team

• Seeks opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

**What We Offer

**At Coop Trading, you'll be part of an international and collaborative environment where you can help shape decisions and contribute to meaningful business results.

**We Offer

**

• An exciting role with broad exposure across the Nordic markets

• The opportunity to shape sourcing strategies and procurement initiatives

• Collaboration with experienced colleagues and stakeholders across four countries

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• A culture built on trust, teamwork, learning, and continuous improvement

• Flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance

Workplace: Our office is located at Skelbækgade 2, 1717 Copenhagen V.

We believe that a positive culture is built through spending time together. Our Vesterbro office is therefore our primary place of work, while we offer the flexibility to work from home when needed.

The role includes approximately 20-35 travel days per year, including occasional overnight stays.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact **Head of Procurement, Nonfood Michael Bjunes at +45 2777 2432.

**If you are ready to join Coop Trading's Procurement team, please send us your application and CV no later than 27th of November 2026. We review applications on an on-going basis.

**About Us

**Coop Trading’s purpose is to make a better every day through leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic consumers delivering the best quality products at a fair price. Our portfolio encompasses both food and daily non-food items within our private brands: Xtra, Coop, and Änglamark.

Coop Trading represents Coop in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, as well as SOK in Finland. Through our private brands, we are proud to be present on every third dinner table in Nordic homes. On behalf of our four partners, we develop products for our private brand portfolio through innovation, product development, and negotiating Nordic agreements.

Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We are 140 dedicated professionals in Denmark and in Spain, as well as a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region. We work to challenge the status quo delivering the best and most innovative private brand products.

A cornerstone of our identity is our continuous commitment to fostering an engaging and appreciative work environment and to being an exceptional place to work.

Are you ready to combine creative craft, 3D design and AI-powered tools to create impactful content at scale?

**As our new AI-Powered Content Designer, you will create and evolve visual content for global campaigns, products and regional markets—balancing brand consistency with local relevance.

In the role of 3D & AI Content Designer in the Global Brand, Content & Digital team, you will create, adapt and scale high-quality visual content, including product CGI and contextual imagery, using AI-powered and 3D design tools.

**The Team You Will Be Part Of

**You will join the Design team within Global Brand, Content & Digital, a creative function responsible for content across launches and campaigns. Reporting to the Senior Design Lead, you will work closely with Brand, Content, Paid Media and regional marketing teams to bring campaign ideas to life across global markets.

We are a collaborative team that combines creative curiosity with structured execution. We use new technologies, including AI, to increase the scale and relevance of our content while maintaining high visual and brand standards.

**Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

**

• Create product CGI, 3D renders and contextual imagery for campaigns, launches and digital channels

• Use AI-powered design tools to create, adapt and iterate visual content for global, regional and local needs

• Translate regional briefs into relevant, high-quality visual assets tailored to audiences, product categories and use cases

• Develop reusable templates, design frameworks and workflows that support efficient content scaling

• Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, visual standards, technical specifications and production requirements

• Partner with regional marketing, Brand, Content and Paid Media teams to understand priorities, market context and audience insights

• Explore new AI and 3D capabilities, contributing ideas that improve creative workflows, content quality and production efficiency

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring experience creating product CGI and 3D renders, using Cinema 4D or similar 3D design software

• May have experience with AI-powered design tools, such as Canva, Leonardo or equivalent platforms, and are ready to explore new technologies

• Bring a graphic design portfolio that demonstrates visual judgement across content types, including composition, typography and colour

• Can interpret creative briefs, communicate design choices clearly and work well with regional and cross-functional stakeholders

• Are curious, structured and self-managing, with the ability to manage several projects, ask thoughtful questions and incorporate feedback

At GN we pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than November 15. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**Highlights

**

• Full-Stack Python/TS engineer needed for a B2B SaaS startup in Copenhagen (with plenty of traction!)

• We have a lean, get-stuff-done team. No annoying extra management layers or unnecessary bureaucratic rituals. And we are "AI-forward" in our own development practices.

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• You will work in a small engineering team, directly with the person who decides what we build, and the problems you spend your time on are hard because the domain is hard, not because the organization is.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

**About Supplios

**Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

**Our Current Stack

**

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

**Essential

**

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

**Nice to have

**Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

**Language

**English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

_Are you passionate about defining and realizing complex technical systems? Do you thrive at the intersection of architecture, development, integration, and validation? Do you want to play a key role in shaping the technical foundation of Kamstrup’s next generation of smart metering solutions?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Lead Systems Engineer, your job will be to drive the technical definition and realization of complex smart metering solutions across hardware, firmware, connectivity, and cloud domains, ensuring robust and verifiable solutions throughout the product lifecycle.

You will act as a key technical authority between architecture and implementation, governing the system's perspective across disciplines and ensuring that system requirements, interfaces, integration, and validation are aligned from concept to deployment.

More specifically you will be:

• Defining and maintaining system requirements, system behavior, and technical specifications.

• Leading technical alignment across hardware, firmware, software, connectivity, and cloud domains.

• Driving system integration and supporting cross disciplinary troubleshooting.

• Ensuring traceability between requirements, design, verification, and validation activities.

• Playing a central role in technical reviews, risk assessments, and critical engineering decisions.

You will experience the opportunity to join a growing Systems Engineering capability and help shape how future smart metering solutions are developed at Kamstrup. Therefore, you will work with advanced connectivity and Internet of Things technologies while collaborating closely with Solution Architects, developers, and product teams. This is a highly visible technical role with significant influence on product direction, engineering excellence, and the future development of the Systems Engineering discipline.

**Meet your future team

**With direct references to the Director of Connectivity, you will become part of the Solutions Architects team within the Water Division. Together with colleagues in Connectivity Development and Connectivity Technology, the team is responsible for defining the solution foundations that enable smart metering products across the Kamstrup portfolio. In the team you will experience an informal and collaborative environment characterized by technical excellence, strong knowledge sharing, and a shared ambition to continuously improve the way we develop products and solutions.

Did you know? Our teams bring together specialists within architecture, connectivity, embedded systems, and product development, creating a unique environment where complex technical challenges are solved through close collaboration across disciplines.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for an experienced Systems Engineer with a proven track record of delivering complex technical solutions in multidisciplinary environments. You achieve work-related goals by combining strong systems thinking with the ability to influence technical direction, drive alignment across engineering domains, and take ownership of technical outcomes.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a similar field.

• Bring extensive experience developing and delivering complex embedded or hardware-based products.

• Possess strong knowledge of systems engineering, requirements engineering, system integration, verification, and validation.

• Demonstrate the ability to drive technical decisions across hardware, firmware, software, connectivity, and cloud domains.

• Have a proven track record of leading technical alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders.

As an added advantage, you may also have experience with requirements management tools, system specification, verification and validation, and wireless communication technologies; familiarity with IoT connectivity solutions across short-range, long-range, and cellular networks; knowledge of standardized interoperability protocols and industry frameworks and the ability to apply a structured and analytical approach to solving complex technical challenges.

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English. Danish proficiency is considered an advantage.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours.

• Employee benefits include a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community.

jobs.description:
If the idea of developing next-generation batteries charges you up, then this PhD position at the Department of Chemistry, DTU, is for you! We use magnetic resonance to understand how batteries work, and why they fail, at the molecular level, so that we can design better materials for safer, longer-lasting and higher-performing energy storage. In this 3-year project, supervised by Assistant Professor Leo W. Gordon, you will learn battery analysis using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) techniques together with a range of electrochemical methods. The expected start date is on, or close to, 1st April, or by mutual agreement.

As the battery field matures, new materials and chemistries will be needed for specific applications. Getting the best performance out of them requires a clear understanding of the chemistry and dynamics inside the cell: how the components interact, how the local structure changes during use, and what leads to degradation. These processes are hard to study without disturbing the sample, and attributing changes in performance to specific species or components needs chemically specific information. NMR is element-specific and non-destructive, which makes it a powerful tool for providing this insight.

This research will develop and apply a suite of NMR characterisation tools to study battery materials and components. Combined with electrochemical characterisation, these methods will build a detailed picture of structure, dynamics and degradation across a range of representative battery systems. The aim is to establish design principles for next-generation batteries.

Responsibilities and qualifications
This project is primarily experimental has a strong emphasis on NMR spectroscopy and electrochemistry. Prior knowledge of NMR and/or electrochemistry are preferred but not required.

Applicants should have a Master’s degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a related field. The ideal candidate should be driven by clean energy and sustainability goals and have a keen interest in developing innovative new methods to understand physical and chemical phenomena across multiple length scales. jobs.description:
The rapid growth of artificial intelligence has made data movement a key bottleneck in computing hardware. Integrated photonics is therefore increasingly used to interconnect electronic processors at a far lower energy per bit than electrical links. Scaling up photonic circuits themselves also requires integrated electronics for large-scale control and stabilization of many optical components in applications, such as biomedical imaging and control of atom-based quantum computers. We offer a PhD scholarship at DTU Electro, where you will develop the 3D integration of photonic and CMOS chips forming the foundation for future technologies.

Our photonic circuits are made in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), which is transparent from the visible to the mid-infrared. Its electro-optic effect allows fast modulation of light without adding optical loss. Our team has recently shown that photonic crystal cavities in TFLN can serve as ultracompact modulators [1] with electrically controllable coupling to waveguides [2], and they can route light between many ports [3]. Small cavities need little energy to drive, but their resonances drift with temperature and fabrication variations. Scaling up circuits therefore requires alignment and stabilization of all resonators via local electronic feedback in addition to high-speed modulation. We work closely with our collaborators at Harvard University, whose research has shaped the TFLN field [4]. 

In the project EPIC, funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark, you will contribute to the design, fabrication, and characterization of devices that join TFLN photonic circuits to custom CMOS chips from our microelectronics team by flip-chip bonding. The aim is to keep many resonator-based modulators, driven at gigahertz speeds, stable at visible and near-infrared wavelengths across a chip. This calls for careful co-design of the photonics with integrated photodetectors, feedback circuits, and drive electronics.

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will help drive the experimental work in EPIC from co-design to demonstration. You will work closely with Professor Per Lynggaard's CMOS design team, other PhD students, postdocs, and senior researchers at DTU, and our collaborators at Harvard University. Depending on your interests, you will have the opportunity to:

• Co-design photonic cavities, couplers, and electronic interfaces using optical, thermal, and circuit simulations.
• Fabricate photonic circuits in DTU Nanolab’s state-of-the-art cleanroom.
• Develop flip-chip bonding of photonic and CMOS chips.
• Explore feedback schemes that stabilize many cavities across a chip.
• Characterize assembled devices using high-speed electro-optic measurements.
• Present your results at international conferences and in leading journals.
You enjoy hands-on laboratory work and learning across disciplines, and you take ownership of the progress and quality of your work.

Required qualifications:

• A strong background in photonics, optics, or electronics.
• Experimental experience in photonics, optics, or electronics, e.g., from your master’s project.
• Programming experience in Python.
Desired qualifications:

• Nanofabrication or integrated photonics.
• Analog circuit design or high-speed electronics.
• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.
